technical-summary: Expanded TRVP16's actionable qualification sections to identify the merged upstream commit, require source-composed safety review and exact multi-RDNA correctness/negative-control evidence, and explicitly require matched end-to-end decode/prefill regression checks. The upstream reported decode regression remains external and is not treated as BigCherry evidence. RV4253 remains closed.
user-summary-candidate: TRVP16 now has concrete review and validation gates for the merged upstream Vulkan collective, including workload regression checks, while preserving PRVP03 as the only implementation owner.
